The popularity of schools among other applicants doesn't affect my chances at any school I apply to – a rejection simply means I'll be considered by the next school on my list.

My values are: w = $83, x = $63, y = $78, z = $73. Therefore, I should rank them in descending order of value. w is the highest at $83, followed by y at $78, then z at $73, and finally x at $63. My priority ranking at each school is irrelevant since rejections don't eliminate me from consideration at other schools. The information about other applicants favoring y > x > w > z is also irrelevant for my individual strategy.
